presets.name: Windows privacy pack
presets.note: Off by default. Stricter than the balanced baseline. Can affect diagnostics and Microsoft features; test Windows Update, Defender, sign-in, Office and Xbox before extending coverage.

presets.name: LG smart-TV privacy pack
presets.note: Off by default. Test streaming, casting, the app store and firmware updates. Review Live Plus, viewing-information consent and ad personalization on the TV as well; menu names vary.

presets.name: Balanced default
presets.note: Conservative product choice; validate household compatibility before deployment.

presets.name: Enhanced privacy
presets.note: Replaces the balanced base rather than stacking Normal and Pro.

presets.name: Compatibility first
presets.note: Alternative to the other base presets, not an additional blanket list.

presets.name: Parental content pack
presets.note: Opt-in; age presets still need review. SafeSearch and YouTube restrictions are separate controls.

presets.name: Social-media schedule pack
presets.scope: assigned profiles during a chosen schedule
presets.note: Blocks whole social services, not just advertising. Off by default.

deploymentGates: Explicitly review and apply the desired policy; this catalog performs no live writes.
Validate supported DNS syntax, reject HTML and error responses, and alert on unexpected count changes.
Retain a last-known-good snapshot on a failed update; implement verified rollback.
Use one base preset at a time. Do not enable optional parental or bypass restrictions for every device.
Keep upstream attribution and distribution notices. Review feed terms before bundling data or a commercial release.
Do not interpret fewer or more entries as a measured protection score. Test printing, updates, streaming, school and work services.
Gateway country policies and provider SafeSearch mappings are separate from domain-list selection.
